file_stem: RWB E1 063 Agent monitoring dashboard v1 E2c
title: Agent monitoring dashboard v1 [E2c]
goal: Risk sees runs, fallback, latency, cost and scores daily, with an alert when the cost cap is breached
why: An agent in use must stay watched. The dashboard reads a daily lake extract, never live tables, and is published only when counts match.
triggers: RW-RISK and RW-COE read Power BI
ace_note: No ACE read. Source is agent_run and agent_policy in the Workbench.

writes.note: one alert per agent, type, segment and date

stores: Data lake table agent_run_daily; Power BI 'Agent monitor v1'; P6 notification interface; outbox (JOB-11)
rules: BR1: the dashboard reads the data lake, never live tables
BR2: publish only when counts match
BR3: alert only when cost is above the cap (2,000 baht)
BR4: one alert per agent, type, segment and date
risks: Count mismatch -> publish held, previous day stays
Notification down -> alert retried by JOB-11
Cost exactly at the cap -> no alert
example: 2026-12-01: INTAKE 120 runs, 9 fallbacks (0.0750), 1,840 baht -> no alert
SCREENING 150 runs, 2,310.50 baht, over the 2,000 cap
